scope: All canonical proposed renders; original evidence and archived revisions excluded from logo replacement
method: Compare original image inventory, dimensions, non-brand region/control geometry and identity; pixel comparison outside existing brand slots and dependent canonical dashboard imagery, with32px allowance for composited blur. Differences up to6/255 per channel outside verified text, limited to max(100 pixels,0.02% of image pixels), are recorded as raster rounding. Larger text-only raster differences are allowed only inside unchanged text rectangles after separate exact text/font/color/style/layout checks; these are rendering differences, not a claim of byte-identical non-brand pixels. Every brand host uses exact approved Shifted right SVG. Unchanged rasters are expected when branding is hidden or outside the captured region.
